train_perturber_model: train a BART-based seq2seq perturbation model using ParlAI formatted data with special tokens
create_PerturberDataset: create a PyTorch Dataset that loads and tokenizes ParlAI formatted perturbation data from CSV
run_compute_metrics: run BLEU metric computation on batch predictions and labels using HuggingFace datasets
parse_training_args: parse command line arguments for model training including epochs, batch size, and data paths
evaluate_perturber_model: evaluate a trained perturbation model and generate text using beam search decoding
